# Toy Theater

> > Free educational games and virtual manipulatives for elementary students, aligned with Common Core standards

Toy Theater provides interactive learning tools covering math fluency, art activities, probability, money concepts, and problem-solving games. Resources include virtual manipulatives for teachers and engaging games that build foundational skills in mathematics, visual arts, and critical thinking for K-5 students.

## Key Topics

- Virtual Manipulatives
- Elementary Math Education
- Common Core Standards
- Math Fluency Games
- Teacher Tools
- Addition & Subtraction
- Place Value
- Fractions
- Time Telling
- Money & Currency
- Art Activities
- Probability & Prediction
- Observation Skills
- Number Sense
- Educational Games

## Math Games & Activities

- [Math Mine Game](https://toytheater.com/math-mine-add-subtract): Addition & subtraction mining game building math fluency for kids
- [Frogwise Time Telling Game](https://toytheater.com/frogwise): Frog-themed analog clock game teaching time-telling skills
- [Pool Place Value Game](https://toytheater.com/pool): Pool game teaching place value & ten frames for numbers 11-19
- [Rainbow Fraction Game](https://toytheater.com/rain-drops): Butterfly coloring fraction game with rainbow color matching
- [More Less Number Comparison](https://toytheater.com/more-less.php): Number comparison game teaching more/less concepts with monsters
- [Climber Probability Game](https://toytheater.com/climber): Probability game using spinners to teach prediction & chance

## Virtual Manipulatives & Teaching Tools

- [Number Chart 0 to 99](https://toytheater.com/number-chart-0-to-99): Interactive 0-99 number chart for counting & skip counting practice
- [Two Color Counter Numbers](https://toytheater.com/two-color-counter-numbers): Two-color counter tool for modeling equations & number sense
- [Play Money United Kingdom](https://toytheater.com/play-money-united-kingdom): UK currency virtual manipulative for teaching pounds & pence
- [Play Money Hong Kong](https://toytheater.com/play-money-hong-kong): Hong Kong currency virtual manipulative for money learning

## Art & Creativity Activities

- [Color Mixer Primary](https://toytheater.com/color-mixer-primary): Interactive primary color mixing tool for exploring color theory
- [Mary Cassatt Doodle Art Activity](https://toytheater.com/doodle-cassatt): Mary Cassatt-inspired doodle art activity with museum resources
- [Build Virtual Building Blocks](https://toytheater.com/build): Virtual building blocks activity encouraging creativity & design
- [Halloween Doodle Art Activity](https://toytheater.com/doodle-halloween): Halloween-themed doodle & coloring activity for creative expression

## Puzzle & Logic Games

- [Twin Tiles](https://toytheater.com/twin-tiles): Tile matching puzzle game with solo or two-player modes
- [Hidden Picture Monster Restaurant](https://toytheater.com/hidden-picture-monster-restaurant): Hidden object game building vocabulary & observation skills
- [Spot the Difference Game](https://toytheater.com/different): Space-themed spot the difference game for visual discrimination
- [Solitaire](https://toytheater.com/solitaire): Classic solitaire card game building problem-solving skills

## Optional

- [The Number Line And River Rapids](https://toytheater.com/number-line-river-rapids): Article on River Rapids game design using number line for subtraction
